sheet.title: Circling Dragons: China 1944-1945 (design prototype)
sheet.source: Designed sheet, not a scan: built by map_graphics/xml/tools/cd/build_cd.py from Natural Earth 1:50M land, lakes and countries, 1:10M river centerlines and ETOPO1 elevations on an Albers equal-area conic (27 N, 45 N; 35 N 118 E); 75 km between hex centers; named ranges, places and networks ruled by hand from the design memorandum (Circling Dragons/circling_dragons_map_and_rules_V3.tex)

panel.text: Pacific War track (exogenous): Soviet entry and surrender change the rules
Soviet staging: Trans-Baikal Front and Mongolia
Off the map until Soviet entry; then enters at the starred hexes: Manzhouli, Tamsag Bulag,
and Sain Shand (Pliyev's Soviet-Mongolian group, 450 km across the Gobi to Dolonnor and Kalgan).
Choibalsan is the railhead from Borzya (1939); everything beyond it moved by truck.
Weather: the divide runs along the Qinling and the Huai (dashed blue line)
Cold: steppe supply distance doubles again, movement -1. Mud: Manchurian plain, movement -1. Monsoon: air support -1.
Soviet staging: Far East
Enters at the starred hexes:
Heihe, Tongjiang, Khabarovsk,
Iman, Suifenhe, Tumen.
India - Burma
Hump airlift and Ledo Road; enters by
the Burma Road at the west edge.
CIRCLING
DRAGONS
China 1944-1945 - Defeat Japan - Control China
Design prototype sheet. One hex = 75 km between centers; equal-area projection.
Terrain: one value per hex. Rivers: operational barriers only. Networks: decisive lines only.
Terrain and features
Clear / plain
Broken / hills
Mountain
Arid / steppe
Marsh / floodplain
Sea
River hexside (blue): Yangtze, Yellow River (1938-47 course), Han, Xiang; Amur, Argun,
Ussuri, Sungari, Nen, Liao, Yalu, Tumen. Minor river (thin blue): Xinqiang, Miluo.
Railway: black, ticked. Strategic road: brown, dashed. Border: red; Manchukuo: purple.
Red square: major city. Gold star: capital. Gold disc: city. White square: town.
Anchor: port (blue: sea; dark blue: river port). Triangle: major airfield. Ellipse: lake.
Red star: Soviet entry hex. Rail segments carry a state in play: Open, Interdicted, Broken.
Initiative / time track: KMT, CCP, J-KMT, J-CCP; one cell = one month
